Age effects The parent and teacher principle components analyses were repeated with the sample split into two age group- ings (3 – 10 years and 11 to 17 years). The results from each of these analyses were very similar to those described above (data not shown) and are not discussed further. Cross-Scale Correlations The cross-scale correlations between the three psycho- pathological subscales are reported separately for each informant in table 11. As a comparison the figures for the same analysis from the original UK description of the psy- chometric properties of the SDQ [16] have been included.
